concept.definition: This document can be directly retrieved via HTTP(s) at its public URL.
This document must be retrieved via a proxy.
This document can be retrieved via Spine Secure Proxy by authorised organisations. The custodian's ASID will be needed and can be found in the context.related field.
This document can be retrieved via the Large Document Retrieval proxy service.
